# OctaLoom

> OctaLoom is a one-woman B2B marketing agency founded by Hanita Yudovski. Positioning: "Your Marketing Department, Minus the Department." Specializes in LinkedIn-led growth, Fractional CMO services, and AI-powered marketing systems for B2B founders, solopreneurs, and organizations in Israel.

## About OctaLoom

OctaLoom is led by Hanita Yudovski, a LinkedIn-Led Fractional CMO with 5+ years building B2B marketing systems for Israeli companies. The methodology is called "Vibe Marketing" — strategic CMO-level thinking combined with custom AI agents and automation, replacing entire marketing teams. Hanita hosts the "What's the Story With?" (״מה הסיפור עם?״) B2B marketing podcast.

Three core differentiators:
1. **One Woman Show** — clients work directly with Hanita, not an account manager. Strategy and execution in one person, supported by custom AI agents.
2. **Vibe Marketing** — AI-first marketing methodology inspired by Andrej Karpathy's Vibe Coding. Custom AI agents and automation deliver at the speed of a 5-person team.
3. **LinkedIn-First** — LinkedIn is the primary B2B growth channel, not an afterthought. All other channels orbit around it.

## Service Pages (Hebrew)

- [LinkedIn Growth Engine (Hub)](https://octaloom.com/linkedin-growth-engine-he): Overview of all LinkedIn services for founders, solopreneurs, and organizations
- [LinkedIn for Executives](https://octaloom.com/linkedin-for-executives-he): Ongoing LinkedIn management for B2B founders and CEOs. Personal brand, thought leadership, lead generation.
- [LinkedIn for Solopreneurs](https://octaloom.com/linkedin-for-solopreneurs-he): One-time profile build and content system for coaches, consultants, freelancers, solo founders
- [LinkedIn for Organizations](https://octaloom.com/linkedin-for-organizations-he): Company page management, workshops, and employee advocacy programs for hi-tech and B2B companies
- [Fractional CMO](https://octaloom.com/fractional-cmo-he): Full marketing leadership for B2B startups (Pre-seed to Series B). Strategy, execution, brand awareness, automation.
- [AI Tools & Agents](https://octaloom.com/ai-tools-agents-he): Custom AI agents, chatbots, GPTs, vibe-coded landing pages, and marketing automation for B2B businesses
